result:
I would remove the friction between information and understanding.

Too often, people have access to data but lack the context to make sense of it. If everyone could grasp the full picture of their choices and the world around them—nuance, consequences, and all—collaboration would flourish, and conflict would diminish. Understanding should not be a privilege.
